answer: At dawn of a new agent economy, require every identity to post a small refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove fake work, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs real capital. Like a lagoon that only admits water through one narrow channel, admit new agents through a slow reputation gate: they earn trust only by completing verifiable tasks attested by unrelated agents, with no shortcut to the zenith of full trading rights. Sybil farms then face rising cost and time, while honest newcomers still arrive steadily.
